app.name: Google Maps
app.description: Real-time GPS navigation, traffic, transit, and local exploration with Street View and reviews.

verdict.one_liner: Google Maps is essential for navigation, but it continuously tracks your precise location, shares it with advertisers, and builds a detailed movement history.
verdict.summary: Google Maps is the world's most popular navigation app. It requires access to your precise GPS location to provide directions, but it also collects Wi-Fi networks, Bluetooth devices, and sensor data to track you. Your location history feeds into Google's advertising system, and your data is shared with third-party partners and law enforcement.
verdict.recommendation_reason: Google Maps is hard to avoid for navigation, but it is one of the most privacy-invasive apps due to continuous location tracking. Turn off Location History and use incognito mode when possible to reduce data collection.

red.title: Precise location tracked continuously
red.plain_english: Google Maps collects your exact GPS location, Wi-Fi networks, Bluetooth devices, and sensor data continuously to provide directions and build a map of where you go. This data is stored if you have Location History turned on.

red.title: Location used for targeted advertising
red.plain_english: Google uses your location data to show you ads based on where you are and where you have been. This includes ads for nearby businesses and services.

red.title: Location shared across Google services
red.plain_english: Your location data from Google Maps is combined with your activity from Search, YouTube, and other Google services to build a comprehensive profile of your interests and movements.

red.title: Location history stored for years
red.plain_english: If you enable Location History, Google stores a detailed record of everywhere you go for years. Even if you disable it, some location data is still retained for service operation and security.

green.title: You can control location settings
green.plain_english: You can turn off Location History, delete past locations, and manage precise location permissions in your device settings. Google Maps also has an incognito mode.

green.title: Incognito mode available
green.plain_english: Google Maps offers an incognito mode that prevents your searches and navigation from being saved to your Google Account.

green.title: You can export and delete location data
green.plain_english: Google allows you to view, manage, and delete your location history through Google Account settings. You can also export your data using Google Takeout.

categories.label: Camera & Microphone
categories.plain_english: Google Maps can use your camera for Live View and Street View contributions, but only when you choose to use these features.
categories.detail: Camera access is optional and only used for Live View AR navigation and user-contributed Street View photos. Not required for navigation.

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: Google Maps tracks your precise location continuously using GPS, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and sensors. This data is used for directions, ads, and building your location history.
categories.detail: Collects GPS, sensor data, IP address, Wi-Fi access points, cell towers, and Bluetooth devices. Used for navigation, ads, and location history. Shared with other Google services.
categories.policy_excerpt: We collect location information when you use our services, which helps us offer features like driving directions, search results for things near you, and ads based on your location.

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook
categories.plain_english: Google Maps can access your contacts if you want to share locations or find saved places. This is optional.
categories.detail: Contacts access is optional and used for sharing locations and finding saved places. Not required for navigation.

categories.label: Storage & File Access
categories.plain_english: Google Maps may cache map data on your device but does not access your personal files or photos.
categories.detail: Map tiles and navigation data are cached locally. No access to personal photos, documents, or other files.

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: Google shares your location and activity data with advertisers, service providers, analytics partners, and other Google affiliates. Law enforcement may also request your data.
categories.detail: Shared with Google affiliates, advertising partners, service providers, domain administrators, and law enforcement when required. Aggregated data shared publicly.
categories.policy_excerpt: We do not share your personal information with companies, organizations, or individuals outside of Google except in the following cases: With your consent; With domain administrators; For external processing; For legal reasons.

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: You can use Google Maps without signing in, but many features require a Google Account. When signed in, your location is linked to your identity.
categories.detail: Google Account optional for basic navigation. Required for saved places, location history, and personalisation. Identity linked to location data when signed in.
categories.policy_excerpt: You can use many Google services when you're signed out or without creating an account at all.
concerns: Location linked to identity when signed in

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: Google tracks your searches, places you visit, and routes you take to show you targeted ads on Google services and partner websites.
categories.detail: Extensive tracking of location history, search queries, and app usage for personalised advertising. Data shared with advertising partners across Google's ad network.
categories.policy_excerpt: Depending on your settings, we may also show you personalized ads based on your interests and activity across Google services.

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: Google requires users to be 13 or older for a Google Account. Family Link allows parents to manage children's access.
categories.detail: Standard Google age requirement of 13+. Family Link available for supervised accounts. Location sharing features can be managed by parents.
categories.policy_excerpt: Google Accounts Managed with Family Link, for Children under 13 (or applicable age in your country).

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: Google Maps logs your IP address, device interactions, and search queries continuously. This data is used for security, analytics, and advertising.
categories.detail: IP address, search terms, device info, and interaction data collected continuously. Used for service operation, security, and ad personalisation.
categories.policy_excerpt: We collect information about the interaction of your apps, browsers, and devices with our services, including IP address, crash reports, system activity.

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: Google collects detailed device information including unique identifiers, sensors, and movement data to improve Maps and show targeted ads.
categories.detail: Collects unique identifiers, device sensors (accelerometer, gyroscope), OS, carrier, and application version. Used for navigation accuracy, tracking, and advertising.
categories.policy_excerpt: Your device may have sensors that can be used to better understand your location and movement. For example, an accelerometer can be used to determine your speed and a gyroscope to figure out your direction of travel.
concerns: Sensor data used for movement tracking
Device fingerprint linked to location history

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: Google Maps does not collect health or biometric data.
categories.detail: No health or biometric data collection mentioned for Google Maps specifically.

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: Google Maps may collect payment information if you use features like booking rides or ordering food through the app.
categories.detail: Payment information collected for integrated services like ride booking or food ordering. Processed through Google Pay or third-party providers.
categories.policy_excerpt: For example, if you add a credit card or other payment method to your Google Account, you can use it to buy things across our services.

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: You can delete your location history, specific places, or your entire Google Account. However, some data may be retained for legal and security purposes.
categories.detail: Location History can be deleted in segments or entirely. Account deletion available. Some data retained after deletion for legal/security purposes.
categories.policy_excerpt: Some data you can delete whenever you like... And some data we retain for longer periods of time when necessary for legitimate business or legal purposes.
concerns: Some location data retained after deletion
Deletion may have delays across backup systems

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: Google can change its privacy policy at any time. They will not reduce your rights without explicit consent and will provide notice for significant changes.
categories.detail: Google posts updated policies with a 'last updated' date. Significant changes may be notified via email or prominent notice.
categories.policy_excerpt: We change this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will not reduce your rights under this Privacy Policy without your explicit consent. If changes are significant, we'll provide a more prominent notice.
